name: cancel-registration-check
title: Cancel registration check stops a slow NHVR request

issue.title: Cancel registration check does nothing while the NHVR request is running
issue.expected: Cancel registration check stops waiting at once and says so.
issue.actual: The click is ignored until NHVR answers.
issue.dt_test: tests/desktop/test_vehicle_ui.py: patch registration.get_json (or the opener) to block, start an NHVR check, click 'Cancel registration check' and assert the status says cancelled within a second and no result is recorded.
suspected: dt/ui.py: registration_rows connects every button, including Cancel registration check, through run_action, which returns while busy()
dt/registration.py: get_json blocks in opener.open for up to 15 s, so even a wired button would wait
